text: 3. The market for canola oil is perfectly competitive and features identical firms. Each has a short- run total cost function of 2Q2 — 15Q + 1,000. Quantity is measured in tons of canola oil. a. What is short-run ATC? Answer: This is simply the total cost divided by Q, 20 — 15 + 25> b. Whatis AVC, AFC, and MC? Answer: AVC = 2Q — 15, AFC = %, and marginal cost is 4Q — 15. c. With a price of $45 per ton, how many tons of canola oil does each firm produce? Answer: The firm will maximize profits by setting marginal revenue (which is simply the price of the canola oil) equal to marginal cost. This corresponds to 15 tons of canola oil. d. At what price will the firm choose to shut down rather than produce? Answer: The firm will produce as long as the marginal cost is greater than average variable cost. This will happen at any price above -$15. Put differently, the firm will shut down only if its profit-maximizing quantity would deliver a profit lower than -1,000, the loss it would suffer as a result of its fixed costs with no output.
